episodes.name: Nitric Acid, Sulfuric Acid, and Dynamite
episodes.overview: Ahead of her sister's wedding, Ko Da Rim heads to Jeju Island, where a sudden encounter leaves her reeling — until she meets Kong Ji Hyeok by a cliff.

episodes.name: Gone with a Kiss
episodes.overview: As their ruse turns into a real spark, Da Rim and Ji Hyeok go on an actual date. Meanwhile, Da Rim's mother collapses after a shocking confrontation.

episodes.name: Ping, Pong, Ping, Pong
episodes.overview: Da-rim and Ji-hyeok's unexpected reunion at work takes a tense turn when he learns of her "marriage" — becoming a ruthless boss as punishment.

episodes.name: His Black Card
episodes.overview: A tense escape from loan sharks brings Ji-hyeok and Da-rim closer, reigniting their spark. Later, Da-rim makes a heartfelt plea to keep her job.

episodes.name: Go Da-rim Is Mine! From Head to Toe!
episodes.overview: After Ji-hyeok pays off Da-rim's debt, he starts meddling in every part of her life — leaving her torn between frustration and affection.

episodes.name: Swayed, Driven Mad
episodes.overview: After witnessing Kim Seon-u's apparent romantic rendezvous with Yu Ha-yeong, Ji-hyeok debates telling Da-rim while caring for Da-rim during her illness.

name: Season 1
overview:
Kong Ji Hyeok works as the leader of the Mother TF team at a baby products company. He is sharp, calm, and executes passionately. One day, a team member, Ko Da Rim, suddenly kisses him. This places him in a difficult position because she is a married woman.

Meanwhile, Ko Da Rim is a single woman who needs a job to support herself. She gets a job as a temporary employee at the baby products company where Kong Ji Hyeok works. She lies about her background and states she is married with a child to get hired there. She now works under Kong Ji Hyeok on the Mother TF team. Her only interest is to become a permanent employee there, but she begins to have feelings for Kong Ji Hyeok.
